note: All raw CPU measurements retained; full input/output JSON snapshots remain in the artifact. This run is INCONCLUSIVE, not accepted latency evidence.

manifest.isolation: One hosted Windows job; serial builds complete before timing; sequential fresh processes; no local/parallel desktop work
manifest.order: Calibration baseline/baseline; paired even baseline/candidate, odd candidate/baseline

comparison.limitation: CPU batch averages; percentiles are across batches, not individual input events or displayed frames. P3 combined rerun required.
